import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode

class Hou_Mcp_Execution_Quality(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_execution_quality"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("execution_result_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("plan_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("history_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_output("overall_score", "float")
        self.add_output("grade", "string")
        self.add_output("dimensions", "any")
        self.add_output("findings", "any")
        self.add_output("quality_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        try:
            from src.runtime.execution_quality import get_execution_quality
            quality = get_execution_quality()

            def _parse(raw, default):
                try:
                    return json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                    return default

            result  = _parse(inputs.get("execution_result_json") or "{}", {})
            plan    = _parse(inputs.get("plan_json") or "{}", None)
            history = _parse(inputs.get("history_json") or "[]", [])

            if not plan:
                plan = None
            if not history:
                history = None

            evaluation = quality.evaluate(result, plan=plan, history=history)
            return {
                "overall_score": evaluation["overall_score"],
                "grade":         evaluation["grade"],
                "dimensions":    evaluation["dimensions"],
                "findings":      evaluation["findings"],
                "quality_json":  json.dumps(evaluation),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"Execution quality error: {e}")
            return {"overall_score": 0.0, "grade": "F", "dimensions": {}, "findings": [], "quality_json": "{}", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Execution_Quality
